meta.greeting: Hi Chrissy — everything on this page is a draft. Nothing goes live until you approve it. Edit anything you like, then tap Send to Hursh at the bottom. It takes about 15 minutes if you use “Approve all shown” on the reviews.

decisions.title: Your hours don’t match across Google, Yelp and the website
decisions.body:
Google Business ProfileTue–Sat 8:30 AM – 4:00 PM
Yelp & InstagramTue–Sat 8:30 AM – 4:00 PM
Website (sweettsbakeshop.mobi)Tue–Sat 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM

Google penalizes mismatched hours and customers show up at the wrong time. Which is right? If Yelp needs fixing too, Hursh needs to be added as a manager on your Yelp for Business account (or you can change it yourself).
options: 8:30 AM – 4:00 PM is correct (fix the website)
10:00 AM – 4:00 PM is correct (fix Google and Yelp)

decisions.title: Which GPS address do you give people?
decisions.body: The old website says 24 Ellis Street. The current site says 1 Ellis St. Both point people to the Kings Court entrance, but only one should appear on Google and the website.

decisions.title: Do you want Hursh to manage Yelp too?
decisions.body: Yelp shows 8:30 AM opening and is otherwise fine. If you want the hours, photos and replies handled there as well, add hurshpatel95@gmail.com as a manager in Yelp for Business (Account → User management).
options: Yes, I’ll add him on Yelp

decisions.short: Chrissy’s last name on the site
decisions.title: How should your name appear on the website?
decisions.body: The “Our Story” page says “sisters Toni and Chrissy Walton”. The Courier-Post article says Dalton. Type the correct spelling.

decisions.title: Holiday hours for Google (optional)
decisions.body: Google lets us post special hours in advance so nobody shows up to a closed shop. Type any dates you’re closed or have different hours for Thanksgiving week, Christmas and New Year’s, e.g. “Closed Nov 27–28, open Dec 24 8:30–2, closed Dec 25–26”.

decisions.title: Heads-up: GoDaddy says “Validate billing details”
decisions.body: In your GoDaddy account both domains show “Validate billing details”, and sweettbakeshop.com auto-renews on Sept 30 — three days from now. That usually means the card on file has expired. Log in to GoDaddy → Renewals & Billing and check the card so the domains don’t lapse.
options: Let sweettbakeshop.com expire, we don’t use it

decisions.title: Add “Cake shop” and “Cupcake shop” to your Google categories?
decisions.body: Google lists you as Bakery (main), Pie shop, Coffee shop, Dessert shop, Wedding bakery and Dessert restaurant. Coffee shop stays — you serve it. We’d like to add Cake shop and Cupcake shop (your biggest searches: “custom cakes near me” gets 22,000 searches a month) and drop “Dessert restaurant”, which you aren’t.
options: Yes, add Cake shop + Cupcake shop, drop Dessert restaurant
Add them but keep Dessert restaurant too

description.current: Quaint bakery owned by a Cake Boss alum, famous for artsy sculpted cakes & treats!
description.draft: Sweet T's Bakeshop is an award-winning custom cake and dessert studio in downtown Haddonfield, NJ, owned by sisters Toni and Chrissy — Toni is a Cake Boss alum. Since 2012 we've made everything from scratch: hand-sculpted and hand-painted specialty cakes, wedding cakes, birthday and baby-shower cakes, cupcakes, French macarons, scones, muffins, pies, cheesecakes and gluten-free treats, plus fresh coffee at the counter. Order standard cakes online for pickup, or call 856-428-0222 to schedule a tasting and custom-cake consultation. Open Tuesday–Saturday, 8:30am–4pm. Serving Haddonfield, Haddon Township, Haddon Heights, Cherry Hill, Collingswood, Voorhees, Marlton, Mount Laurel, Moorestown and all of South Jersey.

reviews.name: Alyssa Guinan
reviews.text: We had Sweet T’s bake for our daughter’s first birthday! Hands down the best sugar cookie we ever had and they nailed the designs that we requested. The cake and cupcake decorations were incredible. They were able to replicate the inspiration photos we shared. Pick up was seamless as well! Super easy pickup, loved the atmosphere of their shop and everyone was so kind. All of our guests kept asking where we got her baked items from and that the decorating was amazing. We’re happy that our guests enjoyed the visual presentation and taste! Our only “gripe” is that we were a little disappointed in the flavor of the fresh strawberries we wanted inside of the cupcake and cake. Don’t get me wrong, our baby girl loved it all and that’s what truly mattered, however, the fresh strawberry was our only negative! Everything else is easily 5 stars and we talked about returning to try their coffee and breakfast items! Thank you again all of you for making our baby girl’s first birthday perfect and memorable to the T 😉

reviews.text:
We contacted Sweet T's Bakeshop through their website for catering our wedding. We ordered two large trays of macarons, got to pick three flavors for each set, and even got to add some decoration onto them! Near the event, I called to check if the order was still good, and the team worked with me the whole way to make sure everything was set up exactly as needed.
One small gripe was that the designs on the macarons were coming off pretty easily as we ate them, but the venue we were in was pretty hot and we received them that afternoon (and the event was a few hours after), so it may have been because of that.
Regardless, every single flavor was sooooo delicious and if you're a fan of macarons, I highly recommend them.

reviews.name: Megan Peagler
reviews.text:
If I had the choice, I would not have used Sweet T’s Bake Shop for our wedding cake, but our venue, The Madison, requires all couples to order through them. Unfortunately, the cake turned out to be a disappointment on several levels.
We ordered two flavors—salted caramel champagne and cookies & cream. At the tasting, I already felt the flavors were a bit bland, but I assumed it would be fine. On the wedding day, the cookies & cream layer was overwhelmed by a harsh chemical taste and smell. The first bite was off-putting, and the scent was just as unpleasant as the flavor. I can’t speak for the salted caramel champagne layer because I didn’t try it myself—and honestly, I don’t know a single guest who did.
To make matters worse, the bakery nickel-and-dimes for anything they consider “additional,” including basic design elements like fondant. For the price we paid, I expected far better quality and service.
We saved the top tier as tradition, but when I moved it from the freezer to bring home, the chemical odor was even stronger—which confirmed that the problem wasn’t just a one-day fluke; the cake itself simply wasn’t good.

Two stars because my mom loved the carrot cake cupcake we got her when we picked up the tasting.
reviews.draft: So sorry to hear that Please call us at 856-428-0222 so we can make it right.

reviews.text: I am very greatful they were able to take my order, it is a treat to be able to order a bakery cake. I was disappointed to see that my order was made incorrectly I did request no sprinkles because of how most conventional sprinkles contain harmful dyes; I wanted portions of the cake to be dye-free for guests. I was dismayed to see glitter sprinkles all over the cake and due to the nature of sprinkles I wasn't able to fix it without ruining the cake. I can see how they wanted to dress up my all white cake but I purchased premium priced dye-free sprinkles to use instead and so, I had to unfortunately inform guests. Most importantly, I wasn't happy with how dry the cake was and how thick the frosting was. I followed thier instructions for keeping the cake strictly. I was so excited to try the cake but, the flavor was just not there. It fell apart as I was cutting due to the sheer weight of the frosting on the top and the inch thick layer on the inside, everyone recieved seperated slices that were falling apart. No one wanted to take any home. It was not what i was expecting for what I paid. The staff are lovely people but it was an embarrassing experience for me and I ended up feeling like a bad hostess because of it.

reviews.text:
Update 8/11/2021
A few months back, I ordered cake/cupcakes for this weekend (August 14th). I had to cancel my original order due to a family emergency, and they were so kind about it. I had rescheduled pick-up and started to coordinate the cupcakes with them through email. Unfortunately, I dropped the ball and thought I had replied and didn't, never confirming the cake and pick up. That was July 17th. I showed up today, August 11th thinking the email was sent. I realized MY ERROR and never replied; I had dropped the ball and am without cupcakes. My anxiety was taking over and not allowing me to place another order or even ask for a substitute. However, Their staff is so incredibly kind and sweet that they could talk to me and help me get myself sorted. They offered to put the cupcakes together by the time I needed them. I was then able to discuss my order with them because of their calm and positive demeanor.  Sweet T's staff are all exceptional, and they go above and beyond for their customers. Thank you !

I have ordered numerous cakes and cupcakes and purchased from the counter, and every single product has been spot on in flavor, texture, and look. I am a very, very picky person, and it is not easy to have a perfect review from me, but they get it 10xs over.  I have never been disappointed by anything they have made, just disappointed i didnt make it there for specific "flavor of the day" cupcakes.  I can not forget The customer service, exceptional too. It was just overshadowed by the amazing delicious treats that i obsess over. 🤣🥰

I recommend Sweet T's Bakeshop 100%. I wanted a special cake for my sister's graduation party, so I researched cake places near her and this shop came up. I read the reviews and reached out to them on March 9 and Michael responded to me the following day.  I sent him a photo of the cake I wanted and I ordered my cake topper from etsy. Since then through May, we kept in touch about changing needs ++ since I would be coming from out of town. On the day I dropped off the cake topper, I saw this cute little shop in person and I must say that their service was superb. The place smelled heavenly (I think I gained 10lbs just from looking at the delicious sweets on display LOL). When I picked up the cake, Michael helped to carefully carry and place it in my sis's vehicle. He went above and beyond to ensure that my experience was great and he did it all with a SMILE and positive remarks.

I ordered a 10" champagne cake with raspberry mousse filling. My sister (graduate) loved the cake and that sealed the deal for me. The cake tasted like heaven. I cut a piece of it and flew back to Dallas with it. 😊 I will definitely visit this location again the next time I'm in NJ.

Sweet T's was the only bakery I called who were nice and accommodating and set up a tasting over the phone. I knew their cakes were good from what many many many people have told us. We went to the tasting and they had everything set up for when we arrived. We wanted a non-traditional flavor, and they told us we could choose cupcakes from their shelf if we wanted to taste it. They were not pushy at all and gave us our space to talk about what we wanted. We went with a smaller 3 tier cake with cookies and cream and also their champagne flavors which were amazing. I showed them a picture from my pinterest board and the cake they made matched it perfectly. We also had some gluten free guests at our wedding, so they were accommodating when we also ordered gluten free cupcakes to be delivered as well. I highly recommend Sweet T's and I cannot wait to go back and get more treats :)

reviews.text: Absolutely THE BEST! Toni and her team hands down really know how to make the best desserts! We got married in November and to this day our wedding guests still rave about the cake and desserts. We did a buffet style dessert table with a generous amount mini apple pies, creme brulees, and various cake bombs. Everyone flocked to the table as soon as dinner was over and left nothing behind! My family is now a long time customer, going back for either a spontaneous treat or desserts and cakes for showers and parties.

reviews.name: 4U2NV KENNELS
reviews.text: I used to get all my family birthday cakes from a place in Philadelphia, but with new management their quality changed.  I was looking for a bakery to due my daughters 1st birthday cake and a mickey mouse clubhouse theme at that. I called sweet t's and the person gave me a quote over the phone,  invited me in to speak with someone and walked me through the options on their website.  After the great customer service over the phone I decided to go with them. I walked in the next day and was treated like family. Greeted at the door, walked through sizes, flavors, and many other options but even moreso I got to speak with one of the bakers/ cake specialist.  When I picked up the cake it was flawless,  no icing out of place not a blemish.  When I cut the cake and  gave it to the party,  compliments were non stop about the flavor and moistness. I advice anyone in the south jersey area to go here. Service and product where impeccable. Sweet T's will get my service for any occasion.

posts.title: Holiday menu is open
posts.photo: a pie or the NY crumb cake
posts.body: Thanksgiving is coming! Pies, cheesecakes, NY crumb and our holiday cakes are open for online ordering now — pick up right here in Haddonfield. Order early, the holiday slots fill up fast.

posts.title: Wedding cake tastings
posts.body: Now booking 2027 weddings! Every wedding cake is custom to you — buttercream, fondant, hand-painted, whatever you dream up. Rated 5/5 on The Knot and WeddingWire. Call 856-428-0222 to schedule a tasting.

posts.title: Gluten-free at Sweet T’s
posts.photo: flourless chocolate cake or GF cheesecake
posts.body: Gluten-free doesn’t mean going without. Flourless chocolate cake, gluten-free cheesecake, GF blueberry crumb pie and GF cupcakes by order. Everything made from scratch in our Haddonfield shop — call ahead and we’ll have it ready.

posts.title: Pumpkin Maple Cake is back
posts.body: It’s back! Pumpkin Maple Cake — spiced pumpkin cake with maple buttercream, only while the season lasts. Order online for pickup or grab a slice in the shop.

qna.q: Do you make gluten-free cakes and treats?
qna.a: Yes! Gluten-free cheesecake, flourless chocolate cake, GF blueberry crumb pie and GF cupcakes by order. Our kitchen isn’t celiac-safe, so please tell us about any serious allergy when you order.

qna.q: How far ahead should I order a custom cake?
qna.a: Custom and sculpted cakes: 2–3 weeks ahead is best, more around holidays. Standard cakes can be ordered online for pickup in a few days. Call 856-428-0222 and we’ll do our best!
Yes — we deliver wedding and event cakes across South Jersey. Pickup at the shop is free; ask about delivery when you order.

qna.q: Do you do wedding cake tastings?
qna.a: Yes! Call 856-428-0222 to schedule a tasting and we’ll design your cake together.
Standard cakes start at $40 for a 6-inch (serves 6–8). Custom and tiered cakes are priced by design and servings — call for a quote.

qna.q: Where do I park, and what address do I use for GPS?
qna.a: We’re at 14 Kings Court in downtown Haddonfield — use the Ellis Street address for GPS. There’s street parking on Kings Court and public lots a block away.
